thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) and Google Buses Again Attacked after 4 years, Investigation Begins

author: Evan Ward
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) and Google Buses Again Attacked after 4 years, Investigation Begins
text:
January 18, 2018 Apple Inc. (AAPL) and Google Buses Again Attacked after 4 years, Investigation Begins 
About four years ago, Google’s shuttle buses were attacked that provide pick and drop facility to the company’s employees. It was a way of protesting the company’s driven gentrification taking place all around San Francisco. It happened again and this time Google is not alone rather Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s charter buses are targeted as well. 
Recently, at least five of Apple’s shuttles have had their windows cracked while traveling. The initial attack took place previous Friday, followed by four more on Tuesday, according to an email sent to the company’s staff. It was alleged that someone has shoot out the windows using pellet guns or possibly throwing rocks. The buses were attacked on highway 280, so the company has decided to divert them from that road, even though doing so would extend the commute time by 30-45 minutes in either direction. 
The same incident occurred with Google bus as it was also attacked on the same road on Tuesday, as reported by SFGate . Consequently, Google is rerouting its shuttles from the highway as well. 
Cited in SFGate’s coverage, California Highway Patrol spokesman Art Montiel told that all attacks took place while the buses were occupied and travelling. However, no injuries to employees have been reported. 
The buses does not show any logos of the companies that hired them. However, the companies are recognizable by the colors of the buses like silver for Apple, white for Google and blue for Facebook, according to a Guardian report. 
The report quoted Montiel as saying that if someone has targeted the buses, they will be on screen soon; they cannot hide themselves for so long. The protests that took place in 2013 and 2014 were in effect of anger over surveillance and automation, gentrification in the Bay Area and also due to the high salaries of tech company employees. 
Apple facilitates its employees through several shuttle buses to transport them from San Francisco down to Cupertino every day and recent attacks show anger against them. An employee who talked to Mashable said that many shuttles have suffered from smashed windows. On an internal email thread, it was expected that it could be the result of “rubber rounds” fired at the buses. There have been four reports at least regarding broken windows on January 16 and January 12. 
According to Mashable, Apple employees were informed about the route variation in an email on Tuesday night. The company said in the email that they are changing route of coaches for the time being due to latest incidents of broken windows along the commute route, especially on highway 280. This change in routes might add 30-45 minutes to commute time in each direction for some riders. The safety of their employees is their first priority as they are working closely with law enforcement to examine these incidents and they will notify their employees as soon as the coaches will be returned to regular route, as said by the company.
